boundary: Exact Ollivier transport curvature for the stated graph measures. It is not measured spacetime curvature, a Ricci tensor of a continuum manifold, or a gravity derivation.
definition: For graph distance d and non-lazy neighbor measure m_x uniform on N(x), kappa(x,y)=1-W1(m_x,m_y)/d(x,y). Equal atomic masses reduce W1 to an integer assignment problem.
interpretation: W33 has positive local transport curvature while the degree-four incidence Levi graph has negative local edge curvature, despite both being finite homogeneous geometries.
